title: Polylogarithm Identities and Arithmetic Reductions
description: Nested sums and iterated integrals establish the common algebra. Cyclotomic Fourier transforms organize special values; algebraic ladders and Gaussian/Eisenstein depth reductions turn experiments into exact identities.

title: Signed Kernels, Zero Geometry and Experimental Discovery
description: Signed moment kernels, exact angular zero counts, all-depth compensation and certified computation develop the analytic geometry. The experimental chapter explains how computations generate proof obligations and how exact certificates settle them.

title: Hurwitz Jets, Stieltjes Calculus and Gamma Correlations
description: Spectral zeta jets unify primitives and parameter derivatives. Canonical finite parts, convolution and contact terms support Gamma correlations and twisted identities; positive kernels explain Stieltjes zero geometry.

title: Gamma Grids, CM Periods and Herglotz Arithmetic
description: Gamma grids and exact certificates lead into complex multiplication, class products and genus ratios. Herglotz functions then connect the period and lattice methods to real-quadratic arithmetic and arithmetic obstructions.
